name: the import root never holds the copied World
the state is written without checking the stage
the write replaces whatever the target holds
a re-sync copies over an edited target
a listed Space with no origin counts as this source's
replace: Rewritable(t, o) == ~cloudTgt /\ ((o.ph = "written" /\ t = Src(o.h)) \/ o = NoOrigin)

name: a written Space is skipped whatever the source head
cleanup deletes without checking the head
replace:
/\ pc = "cleanup" /\ s \in entries \cap src /\ AtHead(s)
  /\ pc = "cleanup" /\ s \in entries \cap src

name: a delete on the target keeps the origin
a source moved during the run leaves the Space not moved
a shared Space is copied
a cloud source deletes a shared Space the target is a member of
replace: IF s \in shared THEN MemberAt(tc[s], s) /\ ~cloudSrc ELSE
IF s \in shared THEN MemberAt(tc[s], s) ELSE

name: an arriving Space can be written by the person
Migrate cleans up without copying the key
a cloud target reads a configured Space at the source head as another's
the cloud limit leaves a local target's Space not moved
a re-sync copies over a target whose membership changed
replace: Rewritable(t, o) == ~cloudTgt /\ o.ph = "written" /\ t.k = "src" /\ t.v = o.h /\ t.e = 0

name: a run that leaves a Space not moved deletes the source sessions
replace:
DeleteSession(x) ==
  /\ pc = "cleanup" /\ lst = "unlinking" /\ ~vol /\ x \in sessions
DeleteSession(x) ==
  /\ ((pc = "cleanup" /\ lst = "unlinking" /\ ~vol) \/ pc = "notmoved") /\ x \in sessions

name: cleanup deletes a Space the target no longer holds
the delete never lists the source again
a session mounts while the account's entries are past ACTIVE
a run starts into an account nobody chose
a key goes before the account's entries are DELETING
replace:
/\ pc = "cleanup" /\ marked /\ lst = "deleting" /\ x \in keys
  /\ pc = "cleanup" /\ x \in keys

name: a mount checks only the deleting mark and recreates the volume
the resume opens an UNLINKING account and recreates its volume
the volume goes before the entries are UNLINKING
replace:
/\ pc = "cleanup" /\ lst = "unlinking" /\ vol
  /\ pc = "cleanup" /\ lst # "active" /\ vol

name: the entries go before the volume
replace:
/\ pc = "cleanup" /\ lst = "unlinking" /\ ~vol /\ x \in sessions
  /\ pc = "cleanup" /\ lst = "unlinking" /\ x \in sessions

name: cleanup deletes a shared Space whose operations the target lacks
replace: IF s \in shared THEN MemberAt(tc[s], s) /\ ~cloudSrc ELSE
IF s \in shared THEN tc[s].k = "member" /\ ~cloudSrc ELSE
